reachability: Pins the vault it reads. There is no validation that `_perpVault` (PerpStakerOracle.sol:24) is a PerpVault, and the address is immutable, so a mis-wired deploy is replaced by pointing the consumer at a new oracle rather than by fixing this one. DERIVED.

A pure read used by the migration vesting contract to decide whether a wallet gets its allocation at once. True when the wallet holds a live share on either side at `ethShareOf` (PerpStakerOracle.sol:30). Both calls are typed and un-caught, so a reverting vault makes every membership test revert; and the test is instantaneous, so one block of staked shares is enough to qualify. DERIVED.
